title: onosma orientalis
intro: Onosma orientalis, commonly known as the golden root or king's crown, is a flowering plant species native to the mountainous regions of Central Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Onosma orientalis include its antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Onosma orientalis contribute to its potential in treating various diseases and promoting overall well-being.
